Class TUIHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.view.TUI.TUIHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
UIHandler
public class TUIHandler extends Object implements UIHandler
Text-based UI handler for TUI VIEW that renders updates and collects player input. It forwards player choices to ClientController actions.
